Answer: B
Reason: The axial CT images demonstrate a large right-sided pleural effusion (fluid collection in the right hemithorax) and extensive pneumomediastinum with gas locules surrounding the esophagus and mediastinal structures. In the context of a suspected aorto-oesophageal fistula, these findings are indicative of esophageal perforation leading to mediastinitis and abscess formation, rather than simple pneumonia or heart failure.
